thread:
emily: Tiny poll - what should we call the new small-chat model in our internal docs? Drop an emoji or name. options: :honeybee: Bee, :snail: Snappy (kidding), :sparkles: Glimmer, or suggest your own. will close at 1pm PT.
noah: Bee :honeybee: - short and buzzy.
harper: Glimmer :sparkles: feels fancy.
lucas: Bee for me.
emily: quick note: keep it <8 chars for the emoji pack.
noah: Suggestion: "Ping"? tiny, network-y.
harper: Ping is good. also adding :snail: as a joke vote for Snappy.
lucas: haha snail stays. real vote: Glimmer.
deploybot: Reaction summary recorded: :honeybee: (2), :sparkles: (2), :snail: (1), text suggestions: Ping (1).
emily: tie between Bee and Glimmer. final call - pick one more reaction now.
noah: +1 Bee.
harper: last minute +1 Glimmer.
emily: ok closing. Results: Bee (3), Glimmer (3), Snappy (1), Ping (1). We'll keep Bee as the short label in the emoji pack and Glimmer as the official doc codename. I'll update the style guide. :sparkles:
lucas: perfect. thanks emily.
emily: will add a tiny note about naming rules in the handbook.
deploybot: FYI: updated emoji pack request queued."
